name: Tempus AI (TEM)
teaser: Do not add. Tempus grows fast, but stock pay is three times its adjusted EBITDA, and at $70.43 the price needs about 21% growth a year for a decade even at bull-case margins; buy range $10.04 to $15.85.
llms: Tempus AI (TEM) sells cancer genomic tests (oncology, hereditary and minimal residual disease) and licenses de-identified clinical and molecular data to drug companies. Valued with a ten-year free cash flow model that counts all stock-based pay as a cost and includes the pending all-stock Personalis acquisition, with a peer revenue multiple as a check only. Stock-based pay of about $215 million in 2026 exceeds adjusted EBITDA of about $65 million; the price implies about 21% revenue growth a year for ten years at bull-case margins. Bear $6.82, Base $21.76, Bull $56.63. Verdict Hold at $70.43 (November 5, 2026 close), do not add, buy range $10.04 to $15.85, maximum buy price $10.04.
